title.value: An Analysis of Dataset Overlap on Winograd-Style Tasks
title.justification: The title is clearly mentioned at the beginning of the paper and reflects the main focus of the research.
title.quote: An Analysis of Dataset Overlap on Winograd-Style Tasks

analysis.description: This paper investigates the overlap between training corpora and test instances in Winograd Schema Challenge (WSC) and similar tasks. The authors analyze the effects of these overlaps on model performance and introduce the KNOWREF-60K dataset, which has a significantly lower proportion of overlaps. The study aims to reveal models’ reasoning capabilities and improve training strategies for common-sense reasoning models.

type.justification: The paper employs experiments to analyze the overlap impact on model performance and introduces a new dataset based on empirical findings.
type.quote: In this paper, we analyze the effects of varying degrees of overlap between these training corpora and the test instances in WSC-style tasks.
